costs.note: Fixed total NQ roundtrip friction, not an extra fee on top. Equal-third sleeves pay proportional full component friction; no netting discount.

inference.gate: At least24 usable months and30 ATR-ready trades per signal; combination requires all three. Positive total netATR and Holm4 p<0.05 -> STATISTICAL_SUPPORT_ON_REGISTERED_REMAINDER, else NO_STATISTICAL_SUPPORT; below floor INCONCLUSIVE. Never live-trading approval.
inference.intervals: Nominal95% percentile mean/total and Sharpe intervals; separate Bonferroni4 simultaneous95% mean intervals (98.75% marginal), approximate bootstrap coverage.
inference.method: Joint moving blocks of consecutive calendar months, exactly frozen survivor bootstrap; daily zero positions retained on every eligible common evaluation day.
inference.tests: Four co-primary two-sided mean daily netATR tests, alpha0.05, Holm4. Raw-point tests and secondary variant descriptive; no second chance. Also report reserved projectwide Holm6 with the two unexecuted afternoon tests assigned p=1.

interpretation: Historical replication under accepted source limitations, not prospective or independent-vendor/tick certification. No claim of proven future profitability.
metrics: Standalone PF and winrate on active daily net P&L (at most1trade/day). Portfolio PF/winrate on aggregated active days, not on component legs. Portfolio trade count counts component executions; raw points are theoretical equal-third contract points.
sensitivity_interpretation: All nine provisional dates already fail full-RTH evaluation or are outside the test window. Both variants keep identical indicator history; zero difference is not proof that provisional history has no indirect effect.
